description: Every system the mashup has and every hook into either game. One row per system; each row is one module of code. natives / bng_api / messages list what the system uses, so the preflight can check every call is defined.

columns.process: Binary it lives in: BeamLS.asi, BeamLS.addon64, BeamNG GE Lua
columns.bng_api: BeamNG Lua calls it makes (sheet bng_api)
columns.messages: Bridge messages it sends or handles (sheet messages)
columns.oracle: How we know it works (log line, test, in-game check)

rows.purpose: Read GTA5.exe's file version, pick the matching native hash table or stay off
rows.oracle: BeamLS.log: 'GTA build 3889 supported'; unit test with fake versions

rows.purpose: Find the native registration table, the native lookup function, the script thread list and the TLS context offsets by byte pattern
rows.oracle: BeamLS.log lists every pattern with its address; unit test on synthetic bytes
rows.notes: Patterns must be confirmed on build 3889 in the running game.

rows.purpose: Call GTA natives by original hash: translate with the build's table, look up the handler, run it with a scrNativeCallContext, copy vector results out
rows.oracle: Self-test at start: GET_GAME_TIMER grows, PLAYER_PED_ID != 0, GET_ENTITY_COORDS near the camera

rows.purpose: Run BeamLS's tick once per game frame on the game's script thread, inside a real script's context, so natives that need a script thread work
rows.oracle: Tick counter in BeamLS.log matches GET_FRAME_COUNT; CREATE_VEHICLE returns a vehicle

rows.purpose: Shut BeamLS down for the rest of the session the moment GTA Online starts or is loading
rows.oracle: Pause menu > GTA Online: BeamLS.log 'online detected, shutting down', proxy car deleted, BeamNG told mode=off

rows.purpose: UDP socket to BeamNG on 127.0.0.1: hello/ack, send queue, receive latest of each message type
rows.oracle: tests/fake_beamng.py answers hello; tests/test_bridge.py round trip

rows.purpose: Every frame send GTA's final rendered camera (position, quaternion, vertical FOV, near clip, viewport size) to BeamNG
rows.oracle: Gold-box test: BeamNG draws a box at the GTA player's position; composite shows it on the player

rows.purpose: While the player drives the proxy car: disable GTA's own vehicle controls and send their values to BeamNG
rows.oracle: Keyboard W/S/A/D and a gamepad move the BeamNG car; GTA's proxy never drives itself

rows.purpose: Create an invisible GTA car sized like the BeamNG car, keep it on the BeamNG car's pose and velocity, let the player get in and out of it
rows.oracle: Proxy follows the BeamNG car within 0.2 m at 100 km/h (BeamLS.log drift stat); traffic brakes for it; player enters with F

rows.purpose: Probe GTA's ground in a grid around (and ahead of) the car with downward shape tests and send the heights
rows.oracle: BeamNG car drives up Vinewood hills and over the Del Perro freeway bridges without falling through

rows.purpose: Cast a ring of horizontal shape tests around the car to find walls, poles and props and send the hits
rows.oracle: Driving into a wall at 50 km/h crumples the BeamNG car's front; no ghost hits on open road

rows.purpose: List GTA vehicles near the car (traffic, police) with pose, velocity, size and class and send them
rows.oracle: Ramming a parked car dents both; a cop ram at 3 stars dents the BeamNG car

rows.purpose: F6 opens BeamNG's vehicle selector, F7 its tuning; also the repair prompt key
rows.oracle: F6 in GTA brings BeamNG's vehicle selector to the front within 1 s

rows.purpose: Find the BeamNG and GTA windows and switch keyboard focus between them for the menus
rows.oracle: Focus returns to GTA after the BeamNG menu closes, without the player clicking
rows.notes: Windows foreground lock: GTA gives focus away (allowed), taking it back needs AllowSetForegroundWindow from BeamNG or the Alt trick.

rows.purpose: When the BeamNG car stops at a Los Santos Customs door, offer and perform a repair
rows.oracle: Stop at LSC Burton with a dented car, press E: the BeamNG car is repaired

rows.purpose: Send GTA's clock so BeamNG's sun matches
rows.oracle: At 21:00 in GTA the BeamNG car is lit for night

rows.purpose: Show help text and notifications in GTA's own HUD
rows.oracle: Help text 'Press F6 to choose a BeamNG car' appears in story mode

rows.purpose: Pause the mashup during loading screens, cutscenes, character switches, death and the pause menu
rows.oracle: Switching to Trevor and back keeps the BeamNG car parked where it was

rows.purpose: The mashup's state machine (off, waiting for BeamNG, on foot, driving, menu) run once per script tick
rows.oracle: BeamLS.log state transitions match a scripted play session

rows.purpose: Publish what the compositor needs (BeamNG car OBB, camera used for BeamNG's last frame, whether to draw) through an export
rows.oracle: Add-on overlay shows the state values live

rows.purpose: Capture BeamNG's window with Windows Graphics Capture straight onto GTA's D3D11 device
rows.oracle: Add-on overlay shows capture size and frames per second

rows.purpose: ReShade effect pass: key out BeamNG's background, depth-test the car against GTA's depth buffer using the car's box, re-project to the current camera
rows.oracle: Lamp posts in front of the car hide it; the car stays glued to the road at 150 km/h in chase cam

rows.purpose: Loaded by the mod's modScript in every BeamNG session; binds the bridge port and does nothing until BeamLS.asi says hello
rows.oracle: BeamNG log 'beamls listener on 47011'; tests/fake_gta.py gets hello_ack

rows.purpose: On hello: load the empty level, hide sky and ground, set the key colour background, hide the UI, keep simulating in the background
rows.oracle: Screenshot of BeamNG shows only the car on flat magenta

rows.purpose: Put BeamNG's free camera exactly where GTA's camera is each frame (pose and FOV)
rows.oracle: Gold-box test (see gta_camera_sync)

rows.purpose: Spawn and place the player's BeamNG car, report its pose, velocity, box and damage every frame, and report what car it is
rows.oracle: tests/fake_gta.py receives car at 60 Hz with sane values

rows.purpose: Apply GTA's controls to the player's BeamNG car through the vehicle VM's input system
rows.oracle: Throttle 1.0 from fake_gta.py accelerates the car in BeamNG

rows.purpose: Turn GTA's ground heights into invisible collision slabs under and ahead of the car
rows.oracle: Car rests on slabs at GTA's ground height (BeamNG log height error < 5 cm)

rows.purpose: Turn GTA's wall and prop hits into invisible collision slabs and posts
rows.oracle: Crash into a GTA wall deforms the car at the right moment

rows.purpose: Mirror nearby GTA vehicles as invisible solid BeamNG proxies that follow GTA's poses and velocities
rows.oracle: Proxy box follows a moving GTA car within 0.3 m; ramming it deforms the player car

rows.purpose: Open BeamNG's vehicle selector or tuning menu on request, pause physics while open, tell GTA when the player is done
rows.oracle: F6 in GTA shows BeamNG's vehicle selector; picking a car and pressing F6 in BeamNG returns to GTA with the new car

rows.purpose: Repair the player's car in place
rows.oracle: Damage value drops to 0 after repair; car keeps its place

rows.purpose: Set BeamNG's time of day from GTA's clock
rows.oracle: Sun direction changes when GTA's clock passes noon

rows.purpose: Add an invisible ocean water plane at GTA's sea level so the car floats and sinks in the Pacific
rows.oracle: Driving off Del Perro pier: the car floats and sinks

rows.purpose: Session extension: dispatches bridge messages to the systems each frame and sends the car state
rows.oracle: tests/test_beamng_lua.lua drives the whole extension with stubs
